title: Blood Incantation's "What's In My Bag?" | Amoeba Music
notes: Canonical acceptance list for phase 1. The 21 bag picks are listed in the YouTube description and should all appear on the review screen, in this order when possible. mentioned_only records are spoken or shown in the video but are not bag picks; the extractor may surface them if marked role=mention, but they must not be auto-ticked and must not be required for acceptance. Description list uses 'Karma Moffett - Sitting Still Within Sitting Still Without' (no slash); the jacket and transcript also use a slash. No YouTube captions were present when fixtures were captured (2026-11-22); ingest must therefore take the audio+faster-whisper path unless a later run finds captions.
